title: Make it yours
content:
## What you'll get

You'll learn the golden rule of customization: ask for one change at a time, point at exactly what you see, and keep iterating until it feels right.

## The golden rule: one change at a time

When you want to tweak your app's look or behavior, **describe one change per message**. Instead of "make the design better," try:

- "Move the Sign In button to the top-right corner"
- "Change the background color to light blue"
- "Make the product title text bigger"

The agent updates the preview automatically after each change. You'll see the result in seconds, and you can immediately ask for another tweak - or undo what you just tried.

<Tip title="Be specific in your change requests">
Instead of "the button looks wrong," try "move the Sign In button to the top-right corner and make it blue." Clear instructions help the agent iterate faster.
</Tip>

## Point at what you see

Use everyday language to describe where something is:

- "the card at the top of the page"
- "the text under the photo"
- "the menu icon on the left side"

If words aren't enough, **upload a screenshot**. Drag an image into the chat and add a short note like "this spacing looks too tight" or "the text is cut off here." The agent will inspect the layout and suggest fixes.

<Callout type="info" title="Screenshot coming soon">
Screenshot to be added.
</Callout>

## Keep iterating or start fresh

Every change builds on the last one. If a tweak didn't land the way you hoped, just ask again:

- "Actually, move that button back to the left"
- "Make the text a bit smaller - that's too big"
- "Go back to the original color"

You can cycle through options as many times as you need. The preview updates each time, so you'll know immediately when something clicks.

If you've gone down a rabbit hole and want to reset, describe your original vision again in a fresh message. The agent will re-approach the design from scratch.

<Callout type="warning" title="Draft - needs review">
This section (a library of copy-paste tweak prompts and the enhance feature) needs product confirmation before publishing.
</Callout>

## If something looks wrong

When you spot a bug or visual glitch, paste the **full error message** from your browser console (right-click and select "Copy") directly into the chat. Add a one-line prompt like "please solve this error" and the agent will diagnose the issue and push a fix.

For layout problems - text cut off, buttons hidden, spacing gone wrong - a screenshot often works better than words. The agent will inspect the component and adjust the styles.

<Warning title="Preview is NOT your deployed app">
The preview environment and your deployed app are **completely separate**. Changes you see in the preview do *not* automatically appear in production.

Until you explicitly deploy (or redeploy), your live app will continue running the last deployed version - even if the preview shows something totally different.
</Warning>

description: Change colors, text, and features by asking - one change at a time.
